name: LoCoMo
description: LoCoMo is a dataset and evaluation benchmark for very long-term open-domain conversations, featuring dialogues with up to 300 turns and 9K tokens on average over up to 35 sessions. It measures long-term memory capabilities of models through tasks such as question answering, event summarization, and multi-modal dialogue generation.
reputation: A newer benchmark for long-term conversational memory that has attracted interest in memory-aware LLM evaluation, but is not yet a widely standardized leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Includes human verification and editing for long-range consistency and grounding to event graphs.
